target_customer: Founders, engineers and knowledge workers on Mac who want an automatic work log
problem: People cannot recall what they worked on and manual time tracking is tedious.
business_model: free open source app with optional paid Dayflow Pro AI
product_category: automatic time tracker, open source Mac app

technical_complexity.rationale: Screen capture plus a multimodal LLM summarizer in SwiftUI, light on research.

defensibility.rationale: MIT licensed and easy to fork; forks exist on GitHub.

market_need_then: Interest in AI screen memory tools was visible through Rewind and Screenpipe; dated evidence not opened.

branding.brand_signature: Open source with a reported 6,600 stars on GitHub (company blog)
branding.community_and_virality: Third party blogs and a Hacker News thread discuss the app; HN comments raised privacy concerns per an aggregator.

brand_strength.rationale: Community attention is mostly around the repo, not the name; no naming story found.

outcome_analysis: Dayflow is an open source Mac time tracker by a solo YC founder that gained GitHub attention but shows no public funding or revenue. It spreads through open source distribution, yet the MIT license and forks mean low defensibility, so the outcome is unclear.
notes: Funding search found nothing; none_found is not zero. Star count is a marketing and aggregator figure. Competitors (Rewind, Screenpipe) are described only in later pages, so none are recorded. Outcome search returned unrelated results. Team size 2 per YC, only one founder named.
